g.text: Sub-mission is a Mission within its SurveyArea.
No separate recipient entity is stored.
At most one finalized attempt per Mission.
A second survey uses a new Mission.
CoverageSnapshot is stored in the attempt.
Analysis model: conceptual attributes and responsibilities, not SQL tables.
Report content is generated from retained domain records; not a stored entity.
Synthetic features reside in Observation; live coverage is calculated on request.
